name: daily-dial-extension
description: Chrome extension: paint your day on a 24-hour dial and see where the time went.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:version
scripts.package: zip -r daily-dial-v$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json dial.html dial.css dial.js lib.js history.js historyLib.js drive.js background.js fonts icons LICENSE -x '.*'
